lifecycle_contract.output_bound: checked Sprintz bound versus Huff0 bound plus the 32-byte pipeline header
lifecycle_contract.return_length: exact Sprintz intermediate and exact serialized Huff0 payload lengths
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: stable tscb_status_v1 including UNSUPPORTED, DST_TOO_SMALL and CODEC_ERROR

stream_components.pipeline_header: 32 bytes carrying width, mode, dimensions, elements, Sprintz bytes and payload bytes
stream_components.payload: one Huff0 block, one constant byte, or exact raw Sprintz bytes
stream_components.layout: all channels form one row-major Sprintz stream before entropy coding
stream_components.accounting: descriptor, both headers, fallback marker and complete payload are charged

upstream_tests.evidence: tools/qualify_sprintz_fire_huff0.py; 8/16-bit, 1/4/128 dimensions, boundary lengths, patterned/random input, observed Huff0/raw modes, truncation, suffix, capacity and canary checks
ASan/UBSan with alignment instrumentation excluded for documented packed x86 accesses; LeakSanitizer not run
runs/runset-20260919T104830Z-d348067cf754: 10 eligible PASS repetitions, one summary and one PASS coverage task

known_limitations: Only lossless homogeneous 8/16-bit integer VALUE objects are registered; float, quantization, validity and heterogeneous widths are unsupported.
One Huff0 block is limited to 128 KiB; negotiation conservatively limits total canonical raw input to 120 KiB.
Huff0 zero return is an explicit raw fallback and Huff0 one return is an explicit constant mode; both remain fully charged.
AVX2, BMI2 and LZCNT are mandatory; there is no scalar fallback, runtime dispatch or non-x86 portability claim.
Alignment sanitizer is excluded and -fno-strict-aliasing is required by upstream packed x86 accesses; LeakSanitizer was not run.
One-shot and single-thread only; streaming, query, random access and checksums are not registered.
Formal evidence uses one deterministic synthetic int16 MTS dataset and does not establish real-data performance.
